mod = 1000000007
result = 1

        result = (result * P) % mod
    print(result)
else:
    cycle = [0] * P
    mark = [False] * P
    lengths = []

    for i in range(1, P):
        if not mark[i]:
            current = i
            length = 0
            while not mark[current]:
                mark[current] = True
                current = (K * current) % P
                length += 1
            cycle[length] += 1
            lengths.append(length)

    for length in lengths:
        val = (length * cycle[length]) % mod
        result = (result * (val + 1)) % mod

    if K == 1:
        result = (result * P) % mod

    print(result)
